name: width/sm
description: The edge of a control or a divider.
why: The Border collection is empty. Every control needs an edge width.

name: width/md
description: The edge of a selected or invalid control, and the active tab's underline.
why: A state shown only by a colour change of a 1 pixel line is easy to miss.

name: ring/width
description: The thickness of the focus ring.
why: WCAG 2.4.13 measures a focus indicator against a 2 pixel perimeter.

name: ring/offset
description: The gap between a control and its focus ring.
why: The gap keeps the blue ring readable beside a pink or black fill.

name: control/sm
description: Height of a small control.
why: Radius has height/32, so a 32 pixel control exists in the design; nothing names its height.

name: control/md
description: Height of a default control.
why: Radius has height/40.

name: control/lg
description: Height of a large control.
why: Radius has height/44.

name: target/min
description: The least height of anything pressed with a finger.
why: 32 and 40 pixel controls are small for a thumb. WCAG 2.2 AA asks 24; Apple and WCAG AAA ask 44.

name: icon/sm
description: An icon inside a small control.
why: No icon size token exists.

name: icon/md
description: An icon inside a default or large control.
why: No icon size token exists.

name: dialog/sm
description: The widest a small dialog grows.
why: A dialog needs a maximum width.

name: dialog/md
description: The widest a default dialog grows.
why: A dialog needs a maximum width.

name: menu/min
description: The least width of a menu.
why: A menu narrower than its trigger looks broken.

name: menu/max
description: The widest a menu grows before its items wrap.
why: Long item text must wrap, not run off the screen.

name: duration/fast
description: A colour change on hover or press.
why: Motion is not started in Figma.

name: duration/base
description: A menu or dialog appearing or leaving.
why: Motion is not started in Figma.

name: duration/spin
description: One turn of a spinner.
why: The Button pilot had to multiply another duration by five to turn its spinner. A loop needs its own token.

name: ease/standard
description: The curve for anything that moves or fades.
why: Motion is not started in Figma.

name: shadow/md
description: A menu floating over the page.
why: Elevation is not started in Figma. A menu on a white page needs more than a faint border to read as above it.

name: shadow/lg
description: A dialog over the scrim.
why: Elevation is not started in Figma.

name: surface/overlay
description: The scrim behind a dialog.
why: No token dims the page behind a dialog.

name: border/strong/default
description: The edge of an input, checkbox or radio at rest: the only thing that shows where the control is.
why: border/primary is 1.35 to 1 against the page in light. WCAG 1.4.11 asks 3 to 1 for the edge of a control. The naming standard's own example is 'add border/strong at 3:1'.

name: border/strong/hover
description: The edge of an input under the pointer.
why: Goes with border/strong/default.
